::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
data("scenarioA")
t = scenarioA$t_myr
pos = "2km"
t_max = max(t)
t_min = min(t)

adm = admtools::tp_to_adm(t = t,
                h = scenarioA$h_m[,pos],
                L_unit = "m",
                T_unit = "Myr")
plot(adm,
     lty_destr = 0)
title(main = "Age depth model")
T_axis_lab()
L_axis_lab()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](day3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Simulate FBD tree:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(4)
t_max = 2
tree = TreeSim::sim.bd.age(age = t_max,
                           numbsim = 1,
                           lambda = 1.5,
                           mu = 0.5,
                           frac = 1,
                           mrca = TRUE,
                           complete = TRUE)[[1]]
plot(tree)
axis(1)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](day3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Simulate fossils along tree


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
f = FossilSim::sim.fossils.poisson(rate = 2.5, tree = tree, root.edge = FALSE)
plot(f, tree)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](day3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
f_extant = FossilSim::sim.extant.samples(fossils = f,
tree = tree,
rho = 1)
plot(f_extant, tree, reconstructed = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](day3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-2.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
plot(f_extant, tree, reconstructed = FALSE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](day3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-3.png){width=672}
:::
:::


simulate morphology along tree


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
d <- sim.morpho(time.tree = tree, k = 2, trait.num = 100,
                br.rates = 0.1,          # scalar = strict clock; vector = relaxed
                variable = TRUE,          # MkV
                ACRV = "gamma", alpha.gamma = 1, ACRV.ncats = 4,
                fossil = f_extant)
d
```
